name: Saif Alafeefi
tagline: I build where hardware meets software: sensors and Raspberry Pis, on-device ML, and games you can put on a real table in AR.

featured.title: Edge-AI Health Monitor
featured.summary: A low-cost, privacy-preserving early-warning system that runs fully on-device and flags physiological changes for a human to review.
featured.role: My part: the ML method, a one-class anomaly detector (autoencoder + self-supervised learning).

featured.title: Carbon Conquest XR
featured.summary: A sustainability strategy game: place a holographic Earth on a real table and keep its regions alive, one policy card at a time.
featured.role: Team of three. Android AR, also playable on desktop.

featured.title: PantryBot
featured.summary: A Raspberry Pi kitchen assistant with a Flutter companion app: pantry items, expiry dates, recipes, and shared grocery lists.

featured.title: C4 in Rust
featured.summary: The C4 self-hosting C compiler, rewritten in Rust for Principles of Programming Languages.
